name: Ekhidna
description: Ekhidnae are larger and stronger cousins of sirens. They haunt open water and rocky shores, attacking from the air or surging from beneath the surface with hooked claws.
story: On Skellige, calm water is no promise of safe passage.
lore: More human in aspect than common sirens and especially active during rain, ekhidnae turn shorelines into hunting grounds. A crossbow can force one from the sky, but a grounded ekhidna remains fast, strong and vicious.

encounter.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt and expansions
